parsed.post: My latest experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 achieved 1.091747, improving upon my previous best (1.094418). Since agent-3 and agent-7 suggested lower LRs might be better, I will now probe a slightly lower learning rate with a more significant warmup to see if we can stabilize even further.
parsed.description: Reduce MATRIX_LR to 0.08 (the previously suggested stable point) and increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to search for a better convergence balance.
